Update the current population pharmacokinetics (PopPK) and ER analysis with this clinical trial data. The trial should enroll sufficient representation of U.S. racial and ethnic minorities to ensure that the results are reflective of the U.S. population. Additionally, the study should follow subjects for a sufficient time after end of dosing to establish the time required to return to baseline grade for neutrophil and platelet count, in the absence of disease progression or subsequent therapy.
